comments.author: callmeal
comments.story: SpaceX Successfully Launches and Lands Second Reused Rocket
comments.why: Example of an earlier failed landing, with video coverage.
comments.text: >It's always been the dodgiest landings that "accidentally" lose video coverage for the longest. Maybe you haven't seen some of the earlier ones that had RUD. Take this[1] one for instance from the SpaceX channel. Looks like they stopped using helicopters to stream the landing. Makes sense, because once you have all the kinks worked out, you no longer need redundant instrumentation. [1] [VIDEO] Edit: Adding a successful one[2]. See how the rocket comes in, pointing away from the barge and then straightens up. [2] [LINK]

comments.story: New Shepard: Bezos claims success on second spaceship flight
